task: Protein subcellular localization from complete amino-acid sequence
task_instruction: Predict the subcellular location of this protein. Use the original DeepLoc/ProtST class IDs and descriptions below. Return only one integer class ID from 0 through 9.
regime: Prompted zero-shot Qwen baseline using native released test sequences, label ontology, and accuracy metric; not a replication of trained protein encoder/classifier heads.
selection_note: Selected shortest correct examples from three localization classes for readable complete sequences; not a representative sample or evidence of strong overall performance.
interpretation_note: These stored predictions match their native gold class. Biological mechanisms and model explanations are unassessed. No new inference or scoring was performed.
